description: Preview whitespace/phone/handle normalization changes (no title-case of stylized names). Phones become E.164, read in the contact's own country (location or address); a number with no country code and no contact country, or one it can't validate, stays as is, listed in phones.review with suggested readings; pass the owner's picks back as phone_choices. ($0.05; API key required)

phone_choices.description: The owner's picks from an earlier preview's phones.review: each is one of that entry's suggestions, applied with the preview.

items.description: Owner pick for one contact, e.g. {"person_id":"3f2a1b4c-8d9e-6f01-c2b3-c4d5e6f70809","e164":"+6591234567"}.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).
